summary: GigCapital7 Corp., a SPAC, filed an 8-K on May 1, 2026, disclosing Non-Redemption Agreements with public stockholders ahead of its May 7, 2026 extraordinary general meeting to approve a business combination with Hadron Energy, Inc. Under these agreements, stockholders holding an aggregate of 1,800,000 Class A ordinary shares agreed not to redeem their shares, with each stockholder capped at 9.99% of outstanding shares. This reduces redemption risk for the SPAC merger. The business combination is governed by a September 27, 2025 agreement, subsequently amended. The filing also includes Regulation FD and Other Events items. Watch for stockholder vote outcome and potential redemptions; risk-arb spread reflects deal certainty.
